entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx: @eigenpal/docx-editor-react: CSS injection and print-time XSS via unescaped embedded font-family name
entry.content:
@eigenpal/docx-editor-react: CSS injection and print-time XSS via unescaped embedded font-family name

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N

Affected:

  • @eigenpal/docx-editor-core — fixed in 1.8.3
  • @eigenpal/docx-editor-react — fixed in 1.8.3

## Summary Embedded font-family names (`word/fontTable.xml`) were interpolated unescaped into an injected `@font-face` `<style>` and into the print window's `document.write()`. A crafted name injects page-wide CSS on open, and breaks out of `<style>` into executable HTML on Print. ## Impact Opening a crafted `.docx` applies attacker-controlled CSS page-wide with zero clicks (overlay/phishing, attribute-selector exfiltration of input values, tracking beacons). Clicking Print escalates to script execution in the embedder's origin. ## Remediation Upgrade to 1.8.3. Font names are CSS-escaped before interpolation (quotes, backslash, `< >`, and CSS newlines), and the print window is assembled with DOM APIs instead of `document.write`.

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:N/PR:N/UI:A/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N

Affected:

  • dompurify — fixed in 3.4.12

## Summary There is a possible hook-policy inconsistency in DOMPurify 3.4.11 involving `CUSTOM_ELEMENT_HANDLING`.
